title: Playback Status Evidence
description: Schema for Display Client playback smoke evidence collected during Streaming Lab test runs.

testRunId.description: Unique identifier for the test run that produced this evidence.

displayId.description: Identifier for the browser display instance, such as DISPLAY_01.

streamUrl.description: HLS stream URL assigned to the Display Client.

sourceId.description: Logical stream/source identifier, such as camera_sync_test.

playbackMode.description: Playback implementation used by the browser client.

playbackStatus.description: Observed playback status at capture time.

currentTimeSeconds.description: Current playback time reported by the browser video element.

autoplay.description: Whether autoplay was enabled for this playback session.

muted.description: Whether the video element was muted during playback.

lastError.description: Last playback or HLS error message, if any.

errorType.description: Error category reported by the playback layer, if any.

errorDetails.description: Additional error details reported by the playback layer, if any.

fatalError.description: Whether the playback error was fatal, if known.

capturedAt.description: Timestamp when the evidence was captured.

evidenceType.description: Type of evidence collection that produced this file.

screenshotPath.description: Relative path to the screenshot associated with this playback status evidence.
